issues.statement: User wants parameter-efficient fine-tuning but hasn't chosen a method
issues.source_fix: Default to LoRA; use DoRA/AdaLoRA for higher quality; IA3 or soft prompts when you need the fewest trainable params
issues.quote: LoRA as the default; DoRA/AdaLoRA for higher quality at slightly more cost; IA3 or soft prompts (prefix/P-tuning) when you need the fewest trainable params

issues.statement: The base model does not fit in VRAM on a single GPU (<24GB)
issues.source_fix: Use QLoRA — load the base in 4-bit and train a LoRA adapter on top
issues.quote: QLoRA — load the base in 4-bit and train a LoRA adapter on top

issues.statement: Model is too large for one GPU even quantized, but multiple GPUs are available
issues.source_fix: Use DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 for the largest models, FSDP for medium models
issues.quote: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 for the largest models; FSDP for medium models

issues.statement: Deciding how to deploy the tuned model — single merged model vs serving multiple tasks from one base
issues.source_fix: merge_and_unload for zero-overhead single-model inference; keep adapter separate and swap with set_adapter for multi-task serving
issues.quote: `merge_and_unload` into one model for zero-overhead inference (LoRA-family only, not on a quantized base); keep the adapter separate and swap with `set_adapter`

issues.statement: Reaching for QLoRA/4-bit even when the bf16 base already fits in memory
issues.source_fix: Use plain LoRA when memory isn't the constraint — 4-bit only adds overhead and a fragile grad path
issues.quote: 4-bit adds dequantization overhead and a more fragile k-bit grad path, for no benefit when memory isn't the constraint.

issues.statement: Setting up a QLoRA run on a 4-bit-loaded base
issues.source_fix: Call prepare_model_for_kbit_training on the loaded model before attaching LoRA
issues.quote: Step 3: Call `prepare_model_for_kbit_training` on the loaded model

issues.statement: Wanting to merge the adapter for zero-overhead inference
issues.source_fix: merge_and_unload works for LoRA-family adapters only, and not on a quantized base
issues.quote: Optionally call `merge_and_unload()` to fold weights in for zero inference overhead (LoRA-family only, not on a quantized base)

issues.statement: Attaching a saved adapter to its base model to generate
issues.source_fix: Use PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, adapter_path), or AutoPeftModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained for one-call loading
issues.quote: Attach the adapter with `PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, adapter_path)`

issues.statement: Task needs an RL/preference-optimization loop (PPO, DPO, reward models)
issues.source_fix: Use trl for the RL loop; PEFT only supplies the adapter that trl trains
issues.quote: For the RL/preference-optimization loop itself (PPO, DPO, reward models) — use `trl` instead; PEFT supplies the adapter that trl trains.

issues.statement: Task needs high-throughput production serving of the merged model
issues.source_fix: Use a dedicated inference engine (e.g. vLLM), not PEFT
issues.quote: For high-throughput production serving of the merged model — use a dedicated inference engine (e.g. vLLM) instead.

issues.statement: Code uses deprecated prepare_model_for_int8_training
issues.source_fix: Replace with prepare_model_for_kbit_training
issues.quote: **`prepare_model_for_int8_training`** (deprecated in 0.4.0) — use `prepare_model_for_kbit_training` instead.

issues.statement: Passing load_in_8bit/load_in_4bit directly to from_pretrained (deprecated)
issues.source_fix: Pass a BitsAndBytesConfig via quantization_config instead
issues.quote: use `BitsAndBytesConfig` passed via `quantization_config` instead.

issues.statement: Estimating whether a given model+method fits on a specific GPU
issues.source_fix: Use the referenced fits — Llama-2-7B QLoRA+TRL on 16GB, 20B RLHF+PEFT+TRL on 24GB
issues.quote: Llama-2-7B with QLoRA + TRL fits on a 16GB GPU; 20B-parameter RLHF with PEFT + TRL fits on a 24GB consumer GPU

issues.statement: Writing a fresh LoRA fine-tuning script
issues.source_fix: Build a LoraConfig (task_type, r, lora_alpha, target_modules), wrap with get_peft_model, train, save adapter
issues.quote: build a `LoraConfig` (`task_type`, `r`, `lora_alpha`, `target_modules`), wrap it with `get_peft_model`

issues.statement: Choosing the wrong task_type for the model head
issues.source_fix: Set task_type to match the head (CAUSAL_LM, SEQ_2_SEQ_LM, SEQ_CLS, TOKEN_CLS, QUESTION_ANS, FEATURE_EXTRACTION)
issues.quote: `task_type` must match the head: `TaskType.CAUSAL_LM`, `TaskType.SEQ_2_SEQ_LM`, `TaskType.SEQ_CLS`, `TaskType.TOKEN_CLS`

issues.statement: Picking the LoRA rank r
issues.source_fix: Start low and raise r only if the adapter underfits
issues.quote: Higher `r` adds capacity at the cost of more parameters; start low and raise only if the adapter underfits.

issues.statement: Choosing lora_alpha relative to r
issues.source_fix: Use the lora_alpha = 2*r heuristic to keep the effective scale at 2
issues.quote: A common heuristic is `lora_alpha = 2 * r`

issues.statement: Not specifying target_modules in LoraConfig
issues.source_fix: PEFT applies a model-type default (often attention query/value projections) when omitted
issues.quote: If omitted, PEFT applies a model-type default (often the attention query/value projections).

issues.statement: Training converges slowly from zero-init adapters
issues.source_fix: Use PiSSA/OLoRA/LoftQ init strings to initialize from a decomposition of the base weights for faster convergence
issues.quote: PiSSA/OLoRA/LoftQ-style strings to initialize from a decomposition of the base weights for faster convergence.

issues.statement: Training is unstable at higher LoRA ranks
issues.source_fix: Enable use_rslora for rank-stabilized scaling (lora_alpha/sqrt(r))
issues.quote: use rank-stabilized scaling (`lora_alpha / sqrt(r)` instead of `lora_alpha / r`), which stabilizes training at higher ranks.

issues.statement: A freshly-initialized head (e.g. classifier) also needs training, not just the adapter
issues.source_fix: Add it to modules_to_save so it trains fully and is saved alongside the adapter
issues.quote: extra modules (e.g. a freshly-initialized classifier head) to train fully and save alongside the adapter.

issues.statement: Want better-than-LoRA quality at low rank
issues.source_fix: Enable DoRA via use_dora=True flag on LoraConfig (not a separate config class)
issues.quote: It typically improves over plain LoRA at low ranks. It is not a separate config class — it is a flag on `LoraConfig`

issues.statement: Considering DoRA when memory/speed is tight
issues.source_fix: Account for DoRA's added magnitude params — slower and more memory than plain LoRA at the same r
issues.quote: DoRA adds the magnitude parameters, so it is somewhat slower and uses more memory than plain LoRA at the same `r`.

issues.statement: AdaLoRA rank schedule desyncs from the actual run length
issues.source_fix: Set total_step to the actual number of optimizer steps; a wrong value desynchronizes the schedule
issues.quote: Set `total_step` to the actual number of optimizer steps in your run; an incorrect value desynchronizes the rank schedule.

issues.statement: Deciding whether AdaLoRA fits the goal
issues.source_fix: Use AdaLoRA for LoRA-level quality under a tight parameter budget, letting it allocate per-layer rank
issues.quote: AdaLoRA is most useful when you want LoRA-level quality under a tight parameter budget

issues.statement: Need the fewest trainable params / fastest to train
issues.source_fix: Use prompt tuning
issues.quote: Fewest parameters, fastest to train → **prompt tuning**.

issues.statement: Need soft prompts that touch every layer for more capacity
issues.source_fix: Use prefix tuning
issues.quote: Soft prompts that touch every layer (more capacity) → **prefix tuning**.

issues.statement: Want LoRA-like quality with even fewer params and no merge into weights
issues.source_fix: Use IA3
issues.quote: LoRA-like quality with even fewer params, no merge into weights → **IA3**.

issues.statement: Need to preserve the base model's behavior (e.g. subject-driven image gen, ControlNet/DreamBooth)
issues.source_fix: Use OFT / BOFT orthogonal fine-tuning
issues.quote: Preserving the base model's behavior (e.g. subject-driven image generation, ControlNet/DreamBooth) → **OFT / BOFT**.

issues.statement: Prompt tuning converges slowly from random init
issues.source_fix: Initialize from real task text with PromptTuningInit.TEXT for faster convergence
issues.quote: Initializing the prompt from real task text (`PromptTuningInit.TEXT`) usually converges faster than random init.

issues.statement: Prompt-tuning TEXT init text doesn't fit the configured virtual-token count
issues.source_fix: Ensure prompt_tuning_init_text fits within num_virtual_tokens (and set tokenizer_name_or_path)
issues.quote: `prompt_tuning_init_text` is tokenized and must fit within `num_virtual_tokens`

issues.statement: Prefix tuning is unstable to train
issues.source_fix: Add the optional MLP reparameterization via prefix_projection to stabilize training
issues.quote: An optional MLP reparameterization (`prefix_projection`) stabilizes training.

issues.statement: Plain prompt tuning underfits
issues.source_fix: Switch to prefix tuning when prompt tuning underfits
issues.quote: prefer prefix tuning over plain prompt tuning when prompt tuning underfits.

issues.statement: Deciding when P-tuning is the right soft-prompt method
issues.source_fix: Reach for P-tuning on natural-language understanding (classification) tasks
issues.quote: P-tuning was designed for natural-language understanding (classification) tasks; reach for it there.

issues.statement: Have multiple related tasks and want cross-task transfer
issues.source_fix: Use multitask prompt tuning to share a prompt across source tasks then specialize
issues.quote: Use it when you have multiple related tasks and want transfer between them.

issues.statement: Verifying the adapter actually wrapped the model
issues.source_fix: Call print_trainable_parameters() — trainable % should be small (often <1%)
issues.quote: `print_trainable_parameters()` is the fastest sanity check that the adapter wrapped correctly — the trainable % should be small (often <1%).

issues.statement: Configuring 4-bit quantization for QLoRA
issues.source_fix: Use the canonical settings — NF4 datatype, nested/double quantization, bf16/fp16 compute dtype
issues.quote: The canonical QLoRA settings use the NF4 datatype, nested (double) quantization, and a bf16/fp16 compute dtype.

issues.statement: Choosing the 4-bit quant type
issues.source_fix: Use nf4 (QLoRA recommendation) over fp4
issues.quote: `bnb_4bit_quant_type` accepts `"nf4"` (normal-float, the QLoRA recommendation) or `"fp4"`.

issues.statement: Wrong bnb_4bit_compute_dtype (e.g. float32) silently slows training
issues.source_fix: Use torch.bfloat16 on Ampere+ (A6000/A100), torch.float16 on older HW; never leave it at float32
issues.quote: should be `torch.bfloat16` on Ampere+ GPUs (A6000, A100), or `torch.float16` on older hardware. Keeping this at float32 silently slows training.

issues.statement: Want a quantized base closer to full precision than 4-bit
issues.source_fix: Set load_in_8bit instead — heavier than 4-bit but closer to full precision; rest of recipe identical
issues.quote: For an 8-bit base, set `load_in_8bit` instead. This is heavier than 4-bit but closer to full precision.

issues.statement: QLoRA 'trains' but loss is flat — no gradient reaches the adapters
issues.source_fix: Call prepare_model_for_kbit_training (mandatory) after loading the quantized base; skipping it is the most common QLoRA failure
issues.quote: Skipping it is the single most common QLoRA failure: the model "trains" but the loss is flat because no gradient reaches the adapters.

issues.statement: Ordering of gradient_checkpointing_enable relative to prepare_model_for_kbit_training
issues.source_fix: Call model.gradient_checkpointing_enable() BEFORE prepare_model_for_kbit_training
issues.quote: if you also call `model.gradient_checkpointing_enable()` yourself, do it **before** `prepare_model_for_kbit_training`.

issues.statement: Ordering of prepare_model_for_kbit_training relative to get_peft_model
issues.source_fix: Call prepare once, immediately after loading the quantized base and before get_peft_model
issues.quote: Call it once, immediately after loading the quantized base and before `get_peft_model`.

issues.statement: print_trainable_parameters reports 0 or an unexpectedly large trainable count
issues.source_fix: The config or preparation step is wrong — fix the LoraConfig or prepare step
issues.quote: If it reports 0 trainable params or an unexpectedly large count, the config or preparation step is wrong.

issues.statement: Setting up multi-GPU LoRA training with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3
issues.source_fix: ZeRO-1/2/3 are all compatible with PEFT LoRA + bitsandbytes; drive it through Accelerate with a config file and accelerate launch
issues.quote: All three stages are compatible with PEFT LoRA + `bitsandbytes`. It is driven through Accelerate

issues.statement: Saved ZeRO-3 adapter isn't reloadable with from_pretrained
issues.source_fix: Set zero3_save_16bit_model: true so saved adapter weights are 16-bit and reloadable
issues.quote: confirm `zero3_save_16bit_model: true` so the saved adapter weights are 16-bit and reloadable with `from_pretrained`.

issues.statement: Combining ZeRO-3 + QLoRA to fit a 70B model on 2×40GB GPUs
issues.source_fix: Meet the version floor: bitsandbytes>=0.43.3, accelerate>=1.0.1, transformers>4.44.2, trl>0.11.4, peft>0.13.0, zero3_init_flag true
issues.quote: Requires `bitsandbytes>=0.43.3`, `accelerate>=1.0.1`, `transformers>4.44.2`, `trl>0.11.4`, `peft>0.13.0`

issues.statement: ZeRO-3 + QLoRA: 4-bit storage dtype must match the model load dtype
issues.source_fix: Set bnb_4bit_quant_storage and the model dtype to the same value (e.g. bfloat16)
issues.quote: The training-code change is the 4-bit storage dtype, which must match the model load dtype

issues.statement: Need to train a large model on a single GPU
issues.source_fix: Use ZeRO-3 with offload_optimizer_device: cpu and offload_param_device: cpu to offload state to CPU
issues.quote: To train a large model on one GPU, offload optimizer and parameter state to CPU.

issues.statement: Running generate() during inference inside a custom (non-Trainer) ZeRO-3 loop
issues.source_fix: Detect ZeRO-3 to gate generate() and use Accelerate's backward
issues.quote: In a custom (non-Trainer) loop, detect ZeRO-3 to gate `generate()` during inference, and use Accelerate's `backward`

issues.statement: Setting up multi-GPU LoRA training with FSDP
issues.source_fix: FSDP shards params/gradients/optimizer states across processes and can offload sharded params to CPU; configure via accelerate config
issues.quote: Fully Sharded Data Parallel shards parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across data-parallel processes and can offload sharded params to CPU.
